6.content: - Prioritize moves that maintain or increase safe distance from hazards (H tiles): assign 0 to moves landing directly on H, very low scores (<50) to moves adjacent to H or that decrease the minimum Manhattan distance to any H, and higher scores only to safe moves that progressively reduce the Manhattan distance to the goal (G). When rating a move, first check if the immediate next tile is H: score 0 if yes. Then compute the post-move minimum Manhattan distance to any H (lower = worse); only if this distance is maintained or increased and the move is safe, positively factor in reduction to G distance. Also, boost scores for moves that make meaningful progress toward G, such as switching directions when continuing straight no longer reduces G distance effectively or gets closer to hazards.
